data_sources.name: NewAPI PostgreSQL logs
data_sources.location: docker exec new-api-postgres psql -U newapi -d new-api, table logs
data_sources.latency_metric: use_time column (seconds, NewAPI upstream round-trip including retries at proxy layer)

data_sources.name: TNexus gateway pipeline_events
data_sources.latency_metric: timings_ms.gateway_wall_ms (milliseconds, end-to-end gateway handler wall time)

data_sources.name: TNexus user_image_records
data_sources.location: docker exec panda-postgres-1 psql -U tnexus -d tnexus
data_sources.note: Persisted successful image artifacts only; no latency

data_sources.name: Gateway docker logs
data_sources.filter: grep 'image call failed|image batch bridge failed'

newapi_logs_all_model_entries.note: Includes both /v1/images/generations AND /v1/chat/completions routed with gpt-image-2 model name. Chat-completions failures (401/502) inflate aggregate error rate.

newapi_logs_images_generations_only.note: Filtered other LIKE '%/v1/images/generations%'. Best proxy for dedicated image API endpoint.

gateway_pipeline_events.endpoint: TNexus gateway POST /v1/images/generations (direct, not via NewAPI proxy)

sample_errors: image poll timeout after 300s (upstream Grok imagine polling)

interpretation.headline_success_rate: Dedicated /v1/images/generations via NewAPI ch115: ~89-90% (7d). Aggregate gpt-image-2 model logs show 38-68% because ~60% of failures are /v1/chat/completions path (401/502), not the image endpoint.
interpretation.latency: Successful image generations take ~40-56s p50 at gateway (pipeline_events) and ~47-56s p50 in NewAPI use_time. p95/p99 tail to 5-7 minutes due to upstream poll timeouts (300s cap).
interpretation.gateway_health: Direct gateway pipeline_events: 100% success (249/249 in 7d). NewAPI-layer and chat-completions-path failures are client-retry/proxy artifacts, not systemic gateway image pipeline failure.
recommendations: Split NewAPI reporting: track /v1/images/generations separately from chat/completions gpt-image-2 entries.
Investigate chat/completions 401 (bad_response_status_code): likely stale Grok account tokens; refresh affected accounts.
429 duplicate_prompt on images/generations (6 in 7d): expected dedup gate; clients should backoff or vary prompts.
Monitor image poll timeout (~300s): upstream Grok imagine latency tail; consider alerting on p95 > 120s.
Re-enable newapi_image_stats_query.sh error detail query: logs table has no message column (use other JSON fields).
